question: Find the antonym of 'Falter'.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Persist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Falter"** means to lose strength or momentum; to hesitate or stumble in action or speech. (डगमगाना, झिझकना)
 
 
• **Example: **She faltered during her speech when she forgot the next line.
 
 
• **"Persist"** refers to continuing firmly or obstinately in an action despite difficulty or opposition. It is the antonym of "Falter" as it represents steadiness and determination. (दृढ़ता से जारी रखना)
 
 
• **Example: **Despite the challenges, he persisted in his efforts to complete the project.
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Falter'** is **'Persist'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Persist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Waver** (डगमगाना): To move unsteadily or show indecision.
 
 
• **Example: **Her confidence wavered when she saw the large audience.
 
 
 
• **Stumble** (ठोकर खाना): To trip or lose balance while walking or to make a mistake in speech or action.
 
 
• **Example: **He stumbled over his words during the presentation.
 
 
 
• **Demur** (आपत्ति करना): To raise objections or show reluctance.
 
 
• **Example: **She demurred when asked to share her personal details.
